summary.text: Brad Hutto is a Democrat from Orangeburg who represents Senate District 40 in the South Carolina Senate, where he has served since April 1996 and is Senate Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Hutto was born August 6, 1957, in Orangeburg, and is a trial lawyer.
He graduated from the University of South Carolina Honors Program with a B.A. in 1978 and from Georgetown University Law Center with a J.D. in 1981.
He chaired the Orangeburg County Democratic Party from 1988 to 1994 and is an Eagle Scout.
His committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Education, Ethics, Finance, Interstate Cooperation, Legislative Oversight and Medical Affairs.
